FILE: app/notes/inset-slide.json
```json
{
  "x": 800,
  "y": 50,
  "width": 300,
  "height": 150,
  "aspect": 2.00
}
```

I wrote `notes/inset-slide.json` using the straightforward normalized-to-pixel mapping for the viewport and the corresponding full-viewport aspect ratio. I wasn’t sure whether `resolveCameraViewport` clamps to the canvas bounds, since the type declarations don’t specify that behavior.
